dependency_admissions.description: AuthCenter OpenID Connect handler for the AUTH-001 BFF login (GATE-002-BFF-001).

Azure SDK for the ADP-001 production adapters (ADP-001-PII-KEYVAULT-ENVELOPE, ADP-001-POD-BLOB-DEFENDER): managed identity, Key Vault envelope and Data Protection KEK, Blob proof storage, and application-read Key Vault secrets (PILOT-KEYVAULT-PRIVATE-APP-READ, decision-log via PR #129: Azure.Security.KeyVault.Secrets 4.11.1). Declares the exact baseline amendments the restore produces: MSAL's Microsoft.IdentityModel.Abstractions 8.14.0 where AUTH-001-OIDC's 8.19.2 is absent, the IntegrationTests Microsoft.Bcl.AsyncInterfaces upgrade, and the framework-pruned Microsoft.Extensions nodes of Paqueteria.Infrastructure and Pricing.Infrastructure.

OpenTelemetry SDK and the official Azure Monitor exporter for the OBS-003 traces and metrics of the API and Worker hosts (OBS-003-TELEMETRY-APPINSIGHTS-2026-10-12: workspace-based Application Insights through the official Azure exporter): Azure.Monitor.OpenTelemetry.Exporter 1.10.0 and OpenTelemetry.Extensions.Hosting 1.19.1 direct in src/Paqueteria.Api and src/Paqueteria.Worker, with their exact transitives. Declares the exact amendments the restore produces (GOV-REL000-CHAINED-UPGRADES-2026-10-12): Azure.Core 1.61.0 -> 1.63.0 and the five moves it forces (System.ClientModel 1.15.0 -> 1.16.0, Microsoft.Identity.Client and Microsoft.Identity.Client.Extensions.Msal 4.84.2 -> 4.90.0, Microsoft.Bcl.AsyncInterfaces and System.Memory.Data 10.0.9 -> 10.0.10), all admitted by ADP-001-AZURE, as additional versions reached by upgrade steps in the Api, Worker, ArchitectureTests and IntegrationTests locks; the IntegrationTests Microsoft.Bcl.AsyncInterfaces step continues the ADP-001-AZURE chain 6.0.0 -> 10.0.9. Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration, Configuration.Binder, Configuration.EnvironmentVariables, Logging.Configuration and Options.ConfigurationExtensions 10.0.0 appear only in the ArchitectureTests lock, which the ASP.NET Core framework does not prune (OBS-003-TEST-EXTENSIONS-ADMISSION-2026-10-12). tests/Paqueteria.RealtimeTestHost/packages.lock.json is not allowed: the dependency PR reverts its newline-only rewrite.
